exact_added_source_record.title: Effective two-index rank formula for arbitrary quadratic biform slices
exact_added_source_record.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
exact_added_source_record.statement: Over any field, for a>=2,b>=3 and nonzero u+zv+z^2w with coefficient degrees below a, divide the common polynomial factor and let D be the maximum remaining degree. Its recurrence kernel has minimal degrees 0<=mu1<=mu2 summing to aD; mu1 is the first nonzero-kernel degree of the explicit coefficient matrix C_ell, found by floor(aD/2). The literal full source rank is ab+min(b,mu1)+min(b,mu2). For D>0, mu1=0 iff the primitive homogeneous z-quadratic has a fixed ground-field linear factor; when aD>b this is equivalent to rank ab+b.
dependencies: Pinned literal crossed source and prior general biform kernel-bundle rank identity
Schoemann-Wiedmann arXiv:1712.03056v1 Theorem2.1 over arbitrary fields
Exact full-output polynomial recurrence with common-factor cancellation
exact_added_source_record.limitations: Individual-source-slice classification and an effective invariant, not a coefficient-degree-only classification, source-space cap, compatible three-leg maps, degeneration or exponent result. Finite controls compare 2010 complete source matrices over Q and the stated finite fields; this corroborates rather than proves the all-size argument. No independent review or formalization.
